Found the relevant files. Now examining the webhook-related code to identify the dispatcher, delivery package, and signing mechanism.

Checking internal/webhook/webhook.go, serverrouter/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go, and server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go to locate the dispatch function, delivery package, and signing mechanism.

Locating the call site of `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in the create handler and confirming the delivery package.

`DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` is located in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. The HTTP delivery is handled by the `webhook` package, specifically `webhook.PostAsync` and `webhook.Post`. The signing mechanism is Standard Webhooks.

The signing mechanism is HMAC-SHA256 per the Standard Webhooks specification. It uses v1 signatures with webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, and webhooksignature headers.

A comment at `memo_service.go:603` identifies `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`.

The dispatcher is `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` handles the HTTP delivery. The signing mechanism is still being identified.

The signing mechanism is HMAC-SHA256 per the Standard Webhooks specification. It is implemented in-house without external libraries such as svix or standardwebhooks.

The signing implementation uses Standard Webhooks "whsec_" secrets. It generates them via `GenerateSigningSecret` and decodes them with `resolveSigningKey`. The HTTP headers are `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` prefixed with `v1,`.
